q2_gaps: a COUNTED PLURAL event-noun used as a temporal anchor ("after two starts") — the anchor rule gives a single event-noun its class atom plus the ordering relation, and says nothing about Before relating a group witness rather than an eventuality

an affiliation / comitative PP modifying a NOUN ("two starts with West Virginia") — the entity-attached surface-preposition licence is stated for position and origin, and CoAgent / Instrument are event-side only
notes: "after" is correctly swapped into (Before starts return), the three proper nouns each carry exactly one surface-preserving Name, and the anchor group rightly gets no roles or tense of its own. `With` is the preposition actually used, so it falls under the open preposition-named licence even though only position and origin are exemplified.
